title: Battle of Mogadishu (1993)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Mogadishu (1993)", at revision 1376073635, opens: "The Battle of Mogadishu, also known as the Black Hawk Down Incident, was part of Operation Gothic Serpent. It was fought on 3–4 October 1993, in Mogadishu, Somalia, between forces of the United States—supported by UNOSOM II—against Somali National Alliance (SNA) fighters and other insurgents in south Mogadishu." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q52226, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle fought on 3 and 4 October 1993, in Mogadishu, Somalia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
